notes: bosonai/higgs-tts-3-4b through the transformers port multimodalart/higgs-audio-v3-tts-4b-transformers (pinned revision, remote modeling code; the safetensors hash matches the official file) and the bosonai/higgs-audio-v2-tokenizer codec. BF16 is 9.3 GB, so the shim loads the backbone as 4-bit nf4 to fit 8 GB; quality loss from that is unmeasured, and the output was not run through speech recognition. Laugh and sigh are sound-effect tags that the maker says go first and are followed by an onomatopoeia, so the bare tag may be weak. Emphasis is a sentence-level prosody tag and is left unmapped. GPU only: a 4B model on the CPU was not tried. One line took about 6 to 7 seconds on a 3060 Ti with the desktop using 2.5 GB of the card.
